I’m picturing a personal bookmark home base that:

- Makes saving nearly effortless by filling in the page details automatically.
- Prevents duplicate copies and brings you back to the existing bookmark.
- Lets you reliably rediscover links through broad, case-insensitive search and your own tags.
- Gives you a focused “read later” pile you can work through and check off.
- Preserves the page’s contents so important material remains available even if the original disappears.

The real goal seems to be turning scattered, forgettable links into an organized, searchable personal library you can trust. Is that the direction you mean?
